"""Command-line interface for CrisprGuard."""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import csv
import io
import json
from pathlib import Path
import sys
from typing import Sequence

from crisprguard import __version__
from crisprguard.design import (
    DesignReport,
    MMEJResult,
    design_guides,
    format_guides_csv,
    format_guides_fasta,
    predict_mmej,
)
from crisprguard.offtarget import OffTargetSummary, clean_dna, scan_offtargets
from crisprguard.samples import get_sample, list_samples
from crisprguard.web.server import serve


def _load_target_and_bg(
    seq: str | None,
    fasta_path: str | None,
    sample_id: str | None,
    bg_fasta_path: str | None = None,
    bg_seq: str | None = None,
    use_sample_bg: bool = True,
) -> tuple[str, str | None, str | None]:
    """Resolve target sequence, optional background FASTA, and optional target label."""
    target_text: str | None = None
    target_label: str | None = None
    background_text: str | None = None

    if sample_id:
        preset = get_sample(sample_id)
        target_text = preset.target_fasta
        target_label = preset.id
        if use_sample_bg:
            background_text = preset.background_fasta
    elif fasta_path:
        path = Path(fasta_path)
        if not path.is_file():
            raise ValueError(f"Target FASTA file not found: {fasta_path}")
        target_text = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
        target_label = path.stem
    elif seq:
        target_text = seq
        target_label = "custom_target"
    else:
        raise ValueError("Provide one of --seq, --fasta, or --sample.")

    if bg_fasta_path:
        bg_path = Path(bg_fasta_path)
        if not bg_path.is_file():
            raise ValueError(f"Background FASTA file not found: {bg_fasta_path}")
        background_text = bg_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    elif bg_seq:
        background_text = bg_seq

    return target_text, background_text, target_label


def _write_output(text: str, output_path: str | None) -> None:
    if output_path:
        Path(output_path).write_text(text, encoding="utf-8")
    else:
        sys.stdout.write(text)
        if not text.endswith("\n"):
            sys.stdout.write("\n")


def _format_design_table(report: DesignReport) -> str:
    lines: list[str] = [
        f"CrisprGuard v{__version__} | Target: {report.target_name} "
        f"({report.target_length} bp, GC {report.target_gc_percent}%%)".replace("%%", "%"),
        f"Enzyme: {report.enzyme_spec.name} | PAM: {report.enzyme_spec.pam_motif} | "
        f"Candidates: {report.total_candidates} (+{report.plus_strand_count} / -{report.minus_strand_count}) | "
        f"Background: {report.background_contigs} contigs ({report.background_bp} bp)",
        "-" * 116,
        f"{'Rank':<5} {'ID':<5} {'Str':<3} {'Cut':>5} {'Spacer':<24} {'PAM':<5} "
        f"{'GC%':>5} {'OnTgt':>6} {'Spec':>6} {'MMEJ%':>6} {'Comp':>6} {'OTs':>4}  Warnings",
        "-" * 116,
    ]
    if not report.guides:
        lines.append("No candidate guides matched the PAM and filter criteria.")
        return "\n".join(lines) + "\n"

    for g in report.guides:
        ot_count = g.offtarget_summary.total_hits if g.offtarget_summary else 0
        warns = ",".join(g.warnings) if g.warnings else "-"
        lines.append(
            f"{g.rank:<5} {g.id:<5} {g.strand:<3} {g.cut_pos:>5} {g.spacer:<24} {g.pam:<5} "
            f"{g.gc_percent:>5.1f} {g.on_target_score:>6.1f} {g.specificity_score:>6.1f} "
            f"{g.mmej.out_of_frame_probability:>6.1f} {g.composite_score:>6.1f} {ot_count:>4}  {warns}"
        )
    return "\n".join(lines) + "\n"


def _format_offtarget_table(summary: OffTargetSummary) -> str:
    lines: list[str] = [
        f"CrisprGuard CFD Off-Target Kinetics | Guide: {summary.guide} ({summary.enzyme})",
        f"Specificity Score: {summary.specificity_score:.2f} / 100 | "
        f"Total CFD Sum: {summary.total_cfd_sum:.4f} | "
        f"Hits (<= {summary.max_mismatches} mm): {summary.total_hits} "
        f"(High-Risk: {summary.high_risk_hits}) | Scanned: {summary.scanned_bp} bp",
        "-" * 110,
        f"{'#':<4} {'Contig':<24} {'Pos':>10} {'Str':<3} {'Alignment':<24} {'PAM':<5} "
        f"{'MM':>3} {'Seed':>4} {'Wob':>3} {'CFD':>8} {'Risk':<9}",
        "-" * 110,
    ]
    if not summary.top_hits:
        lines.append("No off-target sites found within the specified mismatch threshold.")
        return "\n".join(lines) + "\n"

    for idx, hit in enumerate(summary.top_hits, start=1):
        pos_str = f"{hit.start + 1}-{hit.end}"
        lines.append(
            f"{idx:<4} {hit.contig[:23]:<24} {pos_str:>10} {hit.strand:<3} "
            f"{hit.alignment:<24} {hit.pam:<5} {hit.mismatches:>3} {hit.seed_mismatches:>4} "
            f"{hit.wobble_mismatches:>3} {hit.cfd_score:>8.4f} {hit.risk_tier:<9}"
        )
    return "\n".join(lines) + "\n"


def _format_offtarget_csv(summary: OffTargetSummary) -> str:
    buf = io.StringIO()
    writer = csv.writer(buf, lineterminator="\n")
    writer.writerow(
        [
            "contig",
            "start_1based",
            "end_1based",
            "strand",
            "protospacer",
            "alignment",
            "pam",
            "pam_score",
            "mismatches",
            "seed_mismatches",
            "wobble_mismatches",
            "cfd_score",
            "risk_tier",
        ]
    )
    for hit in summary.top_hits:
        writer.writerow(
            [
                hit.contig,
                hit.start + 1,
                hit.end,
                hit.strand,
                hit.protospacer,
                hit.alignment,
                hit.pam,
                hit.pam_score,
                hit.mismatches,
                hit.seed_mismatches,
                hit.wobble_mismatches,
                hit.cfd_score,
                hit.risk_tier,
            ]
        )
    return buf.getvalue()


def _format_mmej_table(result: MMEJResult) -> str:
    ref_line = f"{result.left_flank}|{result.right_flank}"
    lines: list[str] = [
        f"CrisprGuard Bae MMEJ Predictor | Cut Pos: {result.cut_pos} | Window: +/-{result.window_bp} bp",
        f"Out-of-Frame Knockout Probability: {result.out_of_frame_probability:.1f}% ({result.knockout_grade}) | "
        f"In-Frame: {result.in_frame_probability:.1f}% | "
        f"Microhomology Score: {result.microhomology_score:.1f} ({result.total_patterns} patterns)",
        f"DSB Context: {ref_line}",
        "-" * 104,
        f"{'#':<4} {'MH':<9} {'Del':>5} {'Frame':<10} {'Score':>8}  Aligned Deletion Outcome",
        "-" * 104,
    ]
    if not result.top_patterns:
        lines.append("No 2-8 bp flanking microhomology repeats detected around cut site.")
        return "\n".join(lines) + "\n"

    for idx, pat in enumerate(result.top_patterns, start=1):
        frame = "Frameshift" if pat.is_frameshift else "In-Frame"
        lines.append(
            f"{idx:<4} {pat.microhomology:<9} -{pat.deletion_length:<4} {frame:<10} "
            f"{pat.pattern_score:>8.1f}  {pat.aligned_outcome}"
        )
    return "\n".join(lines) + "\n"


def _cmd_design(args: argparse.Namespace) -> int:
    if args.list_samples:
        for preset in list_samples():
            print(f"{preset.id:<16} {preset.name:<26} {preset.locus}")
        return 0

    target_text, bg_text, label = _load_target_and_bg(
        seq=args.seq,
        fasta_path=args.fasta,
        sample_id=args.sample,
        bg_fasta_path=args.background_fasta,
        bg_seq=args.background_seq,
        use_sample_bg=not args.no_sample_bg,
    )
    report = design_guides(
        sequence=target_text,
        enzyme=args.enzyme,
        background=bg_text,
        max_mismatches=args.max_mismatches,
        include_noncanonical_pam=not args.canonical_pam_only,
        mmej_window=args.mmej_window,
        top_n=args.top,
        min_gc=args.min_gc,
        max_gc=args.max_gc,
        target_name=label,
    )

    if args.format == "json":
        out = json.dumps(report.to_dict(), indent=2) + "\n"
    elif args.format == "csv":
        out = format_guides_csv(report.guides)
    elif args.format == "fasta":
        out = format_guides_fasta(report.guides, target_name=report.target_name)
    else:
        out = _format_design_table(report)

    _write_output(out, args.output)
    return 0


def _cmd_offtarget(args: argparse.Namespace) -> int:
    if args.background_fasta:
        path = Path(args.background_fasta)
        if not path.is_file():
            raise ValueError(f"Background FASTA file not found: {args.background_fasta}")
        bg_text = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    elif args.background_seq:
        bg_text = args.background_seq
    elif args.sample:
        preset = get_sample(args.sample)
        bg_text = preset.background_fasta
    else:
        raise ValueError("Provide --background-fasta, --background-seq, or --sample.")

    summary = scan_offtargets(
        guide=args.guide,
        background=bg_text,
        enzyme=args.enzyme,
        max_mismatches=args.max_mismatches,
        include_noncanonical_pam=not args.canonical_pam_only,
        exclude_one_exact=args.exclude_one_exact,
        top_n=args.top,
    )

    if args.format == "json":
        out = json.dumps(summary.to_dict(), indent=2) + "\n"
    elif args.format == "csv":
        out = _format_offtarget_csv(summary)
    else:
        out = _format_offtarget_table(summary)

    _write_output(out, args.output)
    return 0


def _cmd_mmej(args: argparse.Namespace) -> int:
    target_text, _, _ = _load_target_and_bg(
        seq=args.seq,
        fasta_path=args.fasta,
        sample_id=args.sample,
        use_sample_bg=False,
    )
    cleaned = clean_dna(target_text)
    cut_pos = args.cut_pos if args.cut_pos is not None else len(cleaned) // 2
    result = predict_mmej(
        sequence=cleaned,
        cut_pos=cut_pos,
        window=args.window,
        top_n=args.top,
    )

    if args.format == "json":
        out = json.dumps(result.to_dict(), indent=2) + "\n"
    else:
        out = _format_mmej_table(result)

    _write_output(out, args.output)
    return 0


def _cmd_serve(args: argparse.Namespace) -> int:
    serve(host=args.host, port=args.port, open_browser=not args.no_open)
    return 0


def build_parser() -> argparse.ArgumentParser:
    """Build the CrisprGuard CLI argument parser (Python 3.14 percent-escape safe)."""
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(
        prog="crisprguard",
        description=(
            "CrisprGuard: Cas9/Cas12a CRISPR guide RNA designer, CFD off-target kinetics "
            "engine, and Bae MMEJ microhomology frameshift predictor."
        ),
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--version",
        action="version",
        version=f"%(prog)s {__version__}",
    )

    subparsers = parser.add_subparsers(dest="command", required=True)

    # --- design ---
    p_design = subparsers.add_parser(
        "design",
        help="Design and rank SpCas9 or LbCas12a guide RNAs with MMEJ and CFD scores.",
    )
    p_design.add_argument("--seq", help="Raw target DNA sequence.")
    p_design.add_argument("--fasta", help="Path to target FASTA file.")
    p_design.add_argument(
        "--sample",
        choices=["tp53_exon5", "brca1_exon11", "pcsk9_exon1", "egfp_reporter"],
        help="Use a curated human/reporter exon preset.",
    )
    p_design.add_argument(
        "--list-samples",
        action="store_true",
        help="List all curated target gene presets and exit.",
    )
    p_design.add_argument(
        "--enzyme",
        choices=["spcas9", "cas12a"],
        default="spcas9",
        help="CRISPR endonuclease (spcas9 for 5'-20nt-NGG-3', cas12a for 5'-TTTV-23nt-3').",
    )
    p_design.add_argument(
        "--background-fasta",
        help="Optional reference FASTA file for CFD off-target scanning.",
    )
    p_design.add_argument(
        "--background-seq",
        help="Optional raw background DNA string for CFD off-target scanning.",
    )
    p_design.add_argument(
        "--no-sample-bg",
        action="store_true",
        help="Disable automatic loading of the preset's paired off-target background FASTA.",
    )
    p_design.add_argument(
        "--max-mismatches",
        type=int,
        default=4,
        help="Maximum mismatches allowed during CFD off-target scan (default: 4).",
    )
    p_design.add_argument(
        "--canonical-pam-only",
        action="store_true",
        help="Restrict off-target scanning to canonical PAMs only (NGG or TTTV).",
    )
    p_design.add_argument(
        "--mmej-window",
        type=int,
        default=25,
        help="Flanking bp window on each side of the DSB cut site for MMEJ analysis (default: 25).",
    )
    p_design.add_argument(
        "--min-gc",
        type=float,
        default=0.0,
        help="Minimum spacer GC percentage filter, 0 to 100 (default: 0.0).",
    )
    p_design.add_argument(
        "--max-gc",
        type=float,
        default=100.0,

    )

        "--top",

        help="Maximum number of top-ranked guides to output (default: 15).",
    )
    p_design.add_argument(
        "--format",
        choices=["table", "json", "csv", "fasta"],
        default="table",
        help="Output format (default: table).",
    )
    p_design.add_argument("--output", "-o", help="Write output to file path instead of stdout.")
    p_design.set_defaults(func=_cmd_design)

    # --- offtarget ---
    p_ot = subparsers.add_parser(
        "offtarget",
        help="Run PAM-proximal seed-weighted CFD off-target kinetics for a candidate guide.",
    )
    p_ot.add_argument(
        "--guide",
        required=True,
        help="Candidate spacer sequence (20 nt for SpCas9, 23 nt for LbCas12a).",
    )
    p_ot.add_argument("--background-fasta", help="Path to reference background FASTA file.")
    p_ot.add_argument("--background-seq", help="Raw reference background DNA string.")
    p_ot.add_argument(
        "--sample",
        choices=["tp53_exon5", "brca1_exon11", "pcsk9_exon1", "egfp_reporter"],
        help="Scan the paired mini-reference background of a curated sample.",
    )
    p_ot.add_argument(
        "--enzyme",
        choices=["spcas9", "cas12a"],
        default="spcas9",
        help="CRISPR endonuclease model (default: spcas9).",
    )
    p_ot.add_argument(
        "--max-mismatches",
        type=int,
        default=4,
        help="Maximum mismatch count to report (default: 4).",
    )
    p_ot.add_argument(
        "--canonical-pam-only",
        action="store_true",
        help="Only score canonical PAM off-target sites.",
    )
    p_ot.add_argument(
        "--exclude-one-exact",
        action="store_true",
        help="Exclude one exact canonical match (useful when target is inside background).",

        type=int,
        default=20,
        help="Maximum top risk off-target loci to display (default: 20).",
    )
    p_ot.add_argument(

        choices=["table", "json", "csv"],
        default="table",
        help="Output format (default: table).",
    )
    p_ot.add_argument("--output", "-o", help="Write output to file path instead of stdout.")
    p_ot.set_defaults(func=_cmd_offtarget)

    # --- mmej ---
    p_mmej = subparsers.add_parser(
        "mmej",
        help="Predict Bae et al. MMEJ deletion patterns and out-of-frame knockout probability (%%).",
    )
    p_mmej.add_argument("--seq", help="Raw target DNA sequence.")
    p_mmej.add_argument("--fasta", help="Path to target FASTA file.")
    p_mmej.add_argument(
        "--sample",
        choices=["tp53_exon5", "brca1_exon11", "pcsk9_exon1", "egfp_reporter"],
        help="Use a curated sample sequence.",
    )
    p_mmej.add_argument(
        "--cut-pos",
        type=int,
        default=None,
        help="0-based DSB cut boundary index (defaults to sequence midpoint).",
    )
    p_mmej.add_argument(
        "--window",
        type=int,
        default=25,
        help="Flanking bp window on each side of the cut site (default: 25).",
    )
    p_mmej.add_argument(
        "--top",
        type=int,
        default=12,
        help="Number of top microhomology patterns to display (default: 12).",
    )
    p_mmej.add_argument(
        "--format",
        choices=["table", "json"],
        default="table",
        help="Output format (default: table).",
    )
    p_mmej.add_argument("--output", "-o", help="Write output to file path instead of stdout.")
    p_mmej.set_defaults(func=_cmd_mmej)

    # --- serve ---
    p_serve = subparsers.add_parser(
        "serve",
        help="Launch the interactive CrisprGuard dark-lab web workbench.",
    )
    p_serve.add_argument("--host", default="127.0.0.1", help="Bind host (default: 127.0.0.1).")
    p_serve.add_argument("--port", type=int, default=8765, help="Bind port (default: 8765).")
    p_serve.add_argument(
        "--no-open",
        action="store_true",
        help="Do not automatically open a web browser tab.",
    )
    p_serve.set_defaults(func=_cmd_serve)

    return parser


def main(argv: Sequence[str] | None = None) -> int:
    """CLI main entry point."""
    parser = build_parser()
    args = parser.parse_args(argv)
    try:
        return int(args.func(args))
    except ValueError as exc:
        sys.stderr.write(f"Error: {exc}\n")
        return 2


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

"""Cas9/Cas12a CRISPR guide RNA designer, on-target efficiency scorer & MMEJ predictor.

Supports:
  - SpCas9: 5'-[20nt spacer]-[NGG]-3', blunt DSB at -3 bp upstream of PAM.
  - LbCas12a (Cpf1): 5'-[TTTV]-[23nt spacer]-3', staggered 5' overhang DSB (+18/+23 nt).
  - Doench Rule-Set / Kim DeepCpf1-inspired transparent on-target scoring (0..100).
  - Bae et al. (Nature Methods, 2014) Microhomology-Mediated End Joining (MMEJ)
    frameshift / out-of-frame knockout predictor around the exact DSB cut site.
"""

class MMEJPattern:

    """Bae et al. (2014) Microhomology-Mediated End Joining frameshift prediction."""

    cut_pos: int
    window_bp: int
    left_flank: str
    right_flank: str
    window_start_genomic: int
    microhomology_score: float
    out_of_frame_score: float
    in_frame_score: float
    out_of_frame_probability: float  # 0..100 %
    in_frame_probability: float  # 0..100 %
    total_patterns: int
    frameshift_patterns: int
    in_frame_patterns: int
    knockout_grade: str  # 'High KO', 'Moderate KO', 'In-Frame Risk'
    top_patterns: tuple[MMEJPattern, ...]

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, object]:
        data = asdict(self)
        data["top_patterns"] = [p.to_dict() for p in self.top_patterns]
        return data

class OnTargetScoreDetail:
    """Decomposed Doench/Kim-inspired on-target activity score."""

    score: float  # 0..100
    gc_percent: float
    tm_celsius: float
    hairpin_stem_bp: int
    scaffold_stem_bp: int
    estimated_hairpin_dg: float

    seed_t_count: int

    warnings: tuple[str, ...]

        data = asdict(self)
        data["warnings"] = list(self.warnings)
        return data

def gc_content_percent(seq: str) -> float:
    """Compute GC percentage (0..100) ignoring ambiguous N bases."""
    valid = [b for b in seq.upper() if b in "ACGT"]
    if not valid:
        return 0.0
    gc = sum(1 for b in valid if b in "GC")
    return round(100.0 * gc / len(valid), 1)


def estimate_tm_celsius(seq: str) -> float:
    """Estimate RNA:DNA spacer melting temperature (salt-adjusted nearest-neighbor proxy)."""
    s = seq.upper()
    n = len(s)
    if n == 0:
        return 0.0
    gc = sum(1 for b in s if b in "GC")
    # Standard salt-adjusted oligonucleotide Tm (50 mM Na+)
    tm = 64.9 + 41.0 * (gc - 16.4) / n
    return round(tm, 1)


def longest_homopolymer(seq: str) -> int:
    """Return length of the longest identical single-base run."""
    if not seq:
        return 0
    best = 1
    run = 1
    for a, b in zip(seq, seq[1:]):
        if a == b:
            run += 1
            if run > best:
                best = run
        else:
            run = 1
    return best


def analyze_hairpin(spacer: str, enzyme: str = "spcas9") -> tuple[int, int, float]:
    """Detect internal spacer self-complementarity and spacer-scaffold pairing.

    Returns (max_internal_stem_bp, max_scaffold_stem_bp, estimated_dg_kcal).
    """
    s = spacer.upper()
    n = len(s)
    max_internal_stem = 0
    best_dg = 0.0

    # Check internal reverse-complement stems separated by hairpin loop >= 3 nt
    for stem_len in range(min(8, n // 2), 2, -1):
        found = False
        for i in range(n - 2 * stem_len - 2):
            left = s[i : i + stem_len]
            rc_left = reverse_complement(left)
            for j in range(i + stem_len + 3, n - stem_len + 1):
                if s[j : j + stem_len] == rc_left:
                    gc = sum(1 for b in left if b in "GC")
                    at = stem_len - gc
                    # Loop initiation penalty (~+3.6 kcal/mol) plus stacking stabilization
                    dg = round(3.6 - (2.1 * gc + 1.1 * at), 2)
                    if stem_len > max_internal_stem or (
                        stem_len == max_internal_stem and dg < best_dg
                    ):
                        max_internal_stem = stem_len
                        best_dg = min(best_dg, dg)
                    found = True
                    break
            if found:
                break
        if max_internal_stem >= stem_len:
            break

    # Check complementarity against the CRISPR scaffold / direct repeat
    scaffold = (
        SPCAS9_SCAFFOLD_CORE
        if normalize_enzyme(enzyme) == "spcas9"
        else CAS12A_DIRECT_REPEAT
    )
    rc_spacer = reverse_complement(s)
    max_scaffold_stem = 0
    for stem_len in range(min(9, n), 3, -1):
        matched = False
        for i in range(n - stem_len + 1):
            if rc_spacer[i : i + stem_len] in scaffold:
                max_scaffold_stem = stem_len
                matched = True
                break
        if matched:
            break

    return max_internal_stem, max_scaffold_stem, best_dg


def score_on_target(
    spacer: str,
    pam: str,
    enzyme: str = "spcas9",
    downstream_base: str = "",
) -> OnTargetScoreDetail:
    """Compute a Doench Rule-Set / Kim DeepCpf1-inspired on-target activity score (0..100)."""
    enz = normalize_enzyme(enzyme)
    s = clean_dna(spacer)
    p = pam.upper()
    expected = 20 if enz == "spcas9" else 23
    if len(s) != expected:
        raise ValueError(f"{enz} spacer must be {expected} nt (got {len(s)}).")

    gc = gc_content_percent(s)
    tm = estimate_tm_celsius(s)
    internal_stem, scaffold_stem, hairpin_dg = analyze_hairpin(s, enz)
    has_pol3 = "TTTT" in s
    max_homo = longest_homopolymer(s)

    components: dict[str, float] = {}
    warnings: list[str] = []

    if enz == "spcas9":
        # Base logit calibrated so median functional guides score ~55-68, elite guides ~78-92
        logit = 0.35

        # 1. GC optimality (40-65% optimal per Doench 2014/2016)
        if 45.0 <= gc <= 60.0:
            gc_term = 0.55
        elif 40.0 <= gc <= 65.0:
            gc_term = 0.35
        elif 35.0 <= gc < 40.0 or 65.0 < gc <= 70.0:
            gc_term = -0.15
        elif 25.0 <= gc < 35.0 or 70.0 < gc <= 80.0:
            gc_term = -0.70
            warnings.append("extreme_gc")
        else:
            gc_term = -1.35
            warnings.append("extreme_gc")
        components["gc_balance"] = round(gc_term, 3)
        logit += gc_term

        # 2. Doench position-specific nucleotide preferences (1-based pos 1..20)
        pos_term = 0.0
        # Pos 20 (immediately upstream of PAM): G strongly favored, C strongly disfavored
        pos20 = s[19]
        pos_term += {"G": 0.58, "A": 0.14, "T": -0.18, "C": -0.56}.get(pos20, 0.0)
        # Pos 19: G/A favored, C disfavored
        pos_term += {"G": 0.22, "A": 0.15, "T": -0.08, "C": -0.22}.get(s[18], 0.0)
        # Pos 18: C favored (Doench Rule Set 1/2 peak), T/G disfavored
        pos_term += {"C": 0.36, "A": 0.05, "G": -0.12, "T": -0.18}.get(s[17], 0.0)
        # Pos 17: A/C mildly favored
        pos_term += {"A": 0.14, "C": 0.12, "G": 0.0, "T": -0.16}.get(s[16], 0.0)
        # Pos 16: C/G favored, T disfavored
        pos_term += {"C": 0.20, "G": 0.12, "A": 0.0, "T": -0.22}.get(s[15], 0.0)
        # Pos 1 (5' U6 initiation prefers G)
        pos_term += {"G": 0.16, "A": 0.05, "C": 0.0, "T": -0.06}.get(s[0], 0.0)
        # PAM 5' variable nucleotide N in NGG (CGG > AGG/GGG > TGG)
        if len(p) == 3:
            pos_term += {"C": 0.18, "A": 0.08, "G": 0.06, "T": -0.12}.get(p[0], 0.0)
        # Downstream +1 base after NGG (G disfavored per Doench 2014)
        if downstream_base:
            pos_term += {"T": 0.08, "C": 0.06, "A": 0.02, "G": -0.16}.get(
                downstream_base.upper(), 0.0
            )
        components["position_prefs"] = round(pos_term, 3)
        logit += pos_term

        # 3. PAM-proximal 4-nt seed U/T depletion (positions 17..20)
        seed_t = s[16:20].count("T")
        seed_t_term = 0.12 if seed_t == 0 else (-0.18 * (seed_t - 1) if seed_t >= 2 else 0.0)
        if seed_t >= 3:
            seed_t_term -= 0.25
            warnings.append("seed_poly_u")
        components["seed_u_depletion"] = round(seed_t_term, 3)
        logit += seed_t_term

        # 4. Pol III terminator (TTTT) strong penalty
        pol3_term = -1.95 if has_pol3 else 0.0
        if has_pol3:
            warnings.append("pol3_terminator_tttt")
        components["pol3_terminator"] = round(pol3_term, 3)
        logit += pol3_term

        # 5. Homopolymer / G-quadruplex penalty
        homo_term = 0.0
        if "GGGG" in s:
            homo_term -= 0.45
            warnings.append("g_quadruplex_gggg")
        elif max_homo >= 4 and not has_pol3:
            homo_term -= 0.24
            warnings.append("homopolymer_run")
        components["homopolymer"] = round(homo_term, 3)
        logit += homo_term

        # 6. Self-folding hairpin & scaffold interference penalty
        fold_term = 0.0
        if internal_stem >= 6 or hairpin_dg <= -6.0:
            fold_term -= 0.72
            warnings.append("strong_hairpin")
        elif internal_stem == 5 or hairpin_dg <= -4.0:
            fold_term -= 0.35
            warnings.append("moderate_hairpin")
        if scaffold_stem >= 7:
            fold_term -= 0.45
            warnings.append("scaffold_complementarity")
        elif scaffold_stem == 6:
            fold_term -= 0.18
        components["secondary_structure"] = round(fold_term, 3)
        logit += fold_term

        # 7. Melting temperature thermodynamic stability window (52..68 C)
        if 54.0 <= tm <= 66.0:
            tm_term = 0.18
        elif 48.0 <= tm <= 72.0:
            tm_term = 0.0
        else:
            tm_term = -0.30
        components["tm_stability"] = round(tm_term, 3)
        logit += tm_term

    else:
        # LbCas12a (Cpf1) scoring inspired by Kim et al. (Nature Biotechnology, 2018)
        logit = 0.30

        # 1. Optimal GC for Cas12a is slightly lower (35-60%)
        if 40.0 <= gc <= 56.0:
            gc_term = 0.55
        elif 35.0 <= gc <= 62.0:
            gc_term = 0.32
        elif 28.0 <= gc < 35.0 or 62.0 < gc <= 70.0:
            gc_term = -0.22
        else:
            gc_term = -1.10
            warnings.append("extreme_gc")
        components["gc_balance"] = round(gc_term, 3)
        logit += gc_term

        # 2. PAM preference (TTTA/TTTC > TTTG) and 5' seed position preferences (pos 1..8)
        pos_term = 0.0
        if p == "TTTC":
            pos_term += 0.28
        elif p == "TTTA":
            pos_term += 0.22
        elif p == "TTTG":
            pos_term += 0.02
        # Position 1 immediately downstream of TTTV: T strongly disfavored (Kim 2018)
        pos_term += {"C": 0.34, "G": 0.24, "A": 0.12, "T": -0.52}.get(s[0], 0.0)
        # Position 2 & 3 seed GC/C preference
        pos_term += {"C": 0.18, "G": 0.14, "A": 0.04, "T": -0.14}.get(s[1], 0.0)
        pos_term += {"G": 0.16, "C": 0.14, "A": 0.02, "T": -0.12}.get(s[2], 0.0)
        # Position 8 (seed boundary): G/C favored
        pos_term += {"G": 0.14, "C": 0.12, "A": 0.0, "T": -0.10}.get(s[7], 0.0)
        components["position_prefs"] = round(pos_term, 3)
        logit += pos_term

        # 3. 5' seed T count (positions 1..4)
        seed_t = s[0:4].count("T")
        seed_t_term = 0.10 if seed_t == 0 else (-0.20 * (seed_t - 1) if seed_t >= 2 else 0.0)
        if seed_t >= 3:
            warnings.append("seed_poly_u")
        components["seed_u_depletion"] = round(seed_t_term, 3)
        logit += seed_t_term

        # 4. Pol III terminator (TTTT)
        pol3_term = -1.95 if has_pol3 else 0.0
        if has_pol3:
            warnings.append("pol3_terminator_tttt")
        components["pol3_terminator"] = round(pol3_term, 3)
        logit += pol3_term

        # 5. Homopolymer
        homo_term = 0.0
        if "GGGG" in s:
            homo_term -= 0.42
            warnings.append("g_quadruplex_gggg")
        elif max_homo >= 4 and not has_pol3:
            homo_term -= 0.22
            warnings.append("homopolymer_run")
        components["homopolymer"] = round(homo_term, 3)
        logit += homo_term

        # 6. Hairpin & direct-repeat complementarity
        fold_term = 0.0
        if internal_stem >= 6 or hairpin_dg <= -6.0:
            fold_term -= 0.68
            warnings.append("strong_hairpin")
        elif internal_stem == 5 or hairpin_dg <= -4.0:
            fold_term -= 0.32
            warnings.append("moderate_hairpin")
        if scaffold_stem >= 6:
            fold_term -= 0.42
            warnings.append("scaffold_complementarity")
        components["secondary_structure"] = round(fold_term, 3)
        logit += fold_term

        # 7. Tm stability
        if 52.0 <= tm <= 66.0:
            tm_term = 0.15
        elif 46.0 <= tm <= 72.0:
            tm_term = 0.0
        else:
            tm_term = -0.28
        components["tm_stability"] = round(tm_term, 3)
        logit += tm_term

    score = round(100.0 / (1.0 + math.exp(-logit)), 1)
    return OnTargetScoreDetail(
        score=score,
        gc_percent=gc,
        tm_celsius=tm,
        hairpin_stem_bp=internal_stem,
        scaffold_stem_bp=scaffold_stem,
        estimated_hairpin_dg=hairpin_dg,
        pol3_terminator=has_pol3,
        homopolymer_run=max_homo,
        seed_t_count=seed_t,
        components=components,
        warnings=tuple(warnings),
    )


def predict_mmej(
    sequence: str,
    cut_pos: int,
    window: int = 25,
    min_mh: int = 2,
    max_mh: int = 8,
    top_n: int = 12,
) -> MMEJResult:
    """Predict post-DSB MMEJ deletion patterns and out-of-frame knockout probability.

    Implements the Bae et al. (Nature Methods, 2014) microhomology scoring algorithm:
      - Scans `window` bp upstream and downstream of the exact DSB cut site (`cut_pos`).
      - Identifies non-redundant maximal 2..8 bp microhomology repeats spanning the break.
      - Scores each deletion pattern via GC-weighted repeat length and exponential
        deletion-length decay: `100 * (len(mh) + num_GC) * exp(-del_len / 20.0)`.
      - Computes Out-of-Frame Probability % = 100 * sum(score where del_len % 3 != 0) / total_score.
    """
    seq = clean_dna(sequence)
    seq_len = len(seq)
    if cut_pos < 0 or cut_pos > seq_len:
        raise ValueError(f"cut_pos {cut_pos} must be within 0..{seq_len}.")
    if window < 4:
        raise ValueError("window must be at least 4 bp.")

    win_start = max(0, cut_pos - window)
    win_end = min(seq_len, cut_pos + window)
    left_flank = seq[win_start:cut_pos]
    right_flank = seq[cut_pos:win_end]
    l_len = len(left_flank)
    r_len = len(right_flank)

    # Deduplicate by (left_start, deletion_length) while finding maximal microhomologies
    seen_deletions: dict[tuple[int, int], MMEJPattern] = {}

    for i in range(l_len):
        for j in range(r_len):
            # Only start at left-maximal positions so sub-repeats of the same deletion aren't double-counted
            if i > 0 and j > 0 and left_flank[i - 1] == right_flank[j - 1]:
                continue

            # Extend match rightward while matching bases exist
            k = 0
            while (
                i + k < l_len
                and j + k < r_len
                and left_flank[i + k] == right_flank[j + k]
                and left_flank[i + k] != "N"
            ):
                k += 1

            if k < min_mh:
                continue

            # Cap scored microhomology length to max_mh (2..8 bp canonical window)
            eff_k = min(k, max_mh)
            mh = left_flank[i : i + eff_k]
            del_len = (l_len - i) + j
            if del_len <= 0:
                continue

            gc_count = sum(1 for b in mh if b in "GC")
            # Hydrogen-bond strength (AT=1, GC=2) with thermodynamic length cooperativity
            mh_weight = (eff_k + gc_count) * (1.85 ** (eff_k - 2))
            length_factor = math.exp(-del_len / 15.0)
            pattern_score = round(100.0 * mh_weight * length_factor, 2)

            # Build character-aligned post-MMEJ outcome relative to (left_flank + right_flank)
            deleted_seq = left_flank[i + eff_k :] + right_flank[: j + eff_k]
            aligned = (
                left_flank[:i]
                + mh
                + ("-" * del_len)
                + right_flank[j + eff_k :]
            )

            key = (i, del_len)
            candidate = MMEJPattern(
                microhomology=mh,
                mh_length=eff_k,
                gc_count=gc_count,
                left_mh_start=i,
                right_mh_start=l_len + j,
                deletion_length=del_len,
                is_frameshift=(del_len % 3 != 0),
                pattern_score=pattern_score,
                aligned_outcome=aligned,
                deleted_sequence=deleted_seq,
            )
            existing = seen_deletions.get(key)
            if existing is None or candidate.pattern_score > existing.pattern_score:
                seen_deletions[key] = candidate

    patterns = sorted(
        seen_deletions.values(),
        key=lambda p: (-p.pattern_score, p.deletion_length, p.left_mh_start),
    )

    total_score = sum(p.pattern_score for p in patterns)
    oof_score = sum(p.pattern_score for p in patterns if p.is_frameshift)
    inf_score = total_score - oof_score

    if total_score > 0:
        oof_prob = round(100.0 * oof_score / total_score, 1)
        inf_prob = round(100.0 - oof_prob, 1)
    else:
        # Neutral NHEJ frameshift expectation (2/3 out-of-frame) when no repeats exist
        oof_prob = 66.7
        inf_prob = 33.3

    if oof_prob >= 70.0:
        grade = "High KO"
    elif oof_prob >= 55.0:
        grade = "Moderate KO"
    else:
        grade = "In-Frame Risk"

    fs_count = sum(1 for p in patterns if p.is_frameshift)

    return MMEJResult(
        cut_pos=cut_pos,
        window_bp=window,
        left_flank=left_flank,
        right_flank=right_flank,
        window_start_genomic=win_start,
        microhomology_score=round(total_score, 1),
        out_of_frame_score=round(oof_score, 1),
        in_frame_score=round(inf_score, 1),
        out_of_frame_probability=oof_prob,
        in_frame_probability=inf_prob,
        total_patterns=len(patterns),
        frameshift_patterns=fs_count,
        in_frame_patterns=len(patterns) - fs_count,
        knockout_grade=grade,
        top_patterns=tuple(patterns[:top_n]),
    )


def _extract_context_30nt(strand_seq: str, start: int, end: int, enzyme: str) -> str:
    """Extract a 30-nt context window around a protospacer+PAM match on the matching strand."""
    seq_len = len(strand_seq)
    if enzyme == "spcas9":
        # 4 nt upstream + 20 nt spacer + 3 nt PAM + 3 nt downstream = 30 nt
        c_start = max(0, start - 4)
        c_end = min(seq_len, end + 3)
    else:
        # 1 nt upstream + 4 nt PAM + 23 nt spacer + 2 nt downstream = 30 nt
        c_start = max(0, start - 1)
        c_end = min(seq_len, end + 2)
    return strand_seq[c_start:c_end]


def design_guides(
    sequence: str,
    enzyme: str = "spcas9",
    background: str | Sequence[tuple[str, str]] | None = None,
    max_mismatches: int = 4,
    include_noncanonical_pam: bool = True,
    mmej_window: int = 25,
    top_n: int | None = None,
    min_gc: float = 0.0,
    max_gc: float = 100.0,
    target_name: str | None = None,
) -> DesignReport:
    """Scan both strands of a target DNA sequence to design & rank optimal CRISPR guides."""
    enz = normalize_enzyme(enzyme)
    spec = ENZYME_SPECS[enz]
    target_records = parse_fasta(sequence, default_name=target_name or "target")
    rec_name, seq = target_records[0]
    if target_name:
        rec_name = target_name
    seq_len = len(seq)
    rc_seq = reverse_complement(seq)

    # Prepare off-target background contigs
    bg_contigs: list[tuple[str, str]] = []
    if background is not None:
        if isinstance(background, str):
            if background.strip():
                bg_contigs = parse_fasta(background, default_name="background")
        else:
            bg_contigs = [(n, clean_dna(s)) for n, s in background if s.strip()]

    0.36, 0.29, 0.23, 0.18, 0.14,  # 11..15 Seed entry
    0.11, 0.085, 0.065, 0.050, 0.040,  # 16..20 Core PAM-proximal seed

def normalize_enzyme(enzyme: str) -> str:
    """Normalize enzyme alias to canonical 'spcas9' or 'cas12a'."""
    key = (enzyme or "spcas9").strip().lower().replace("-", "").replace("_", "")
    if key in {"spcas9", "cas9", "ngg"}:
        return "spcas9"
    if key in {"cas12a", "lbcas12a", "ascas12a", "cpf1", "tttv"}:
        return "cas12a"
    raise ValueError(f"Unsupported enzyme '{enzyme}'. Expected 'spcas9' or 'cas12a'.")


def reverse_complement(seq: str) -> str:
    """Return the reverse complement of a DNA sequence."""
    return seq.translate(DNA_COMPLEMENT)[::-1]


def clean_dna(raw: str) -> str:
    """Clean a raw DNA string or single FASTA entry into uppercase A/C/G/T/N."""
    if not raw or not raw.strip():
        raise ValueError("DNA sequence input is empty.")
    lines: list[str] = []
    for line in raw.strip().splitlines():
        stripped = line.strip()
        if not stripped or stripped.startswith(">") or stripped.startswith(";"):
            continue
        lines.append(stripped)
    cleaned = re.sub(r"[\s0-9]+", "", "".join(lines)).upper().replace("U", "T")
    if not cleaned:
        raise ValueError("No nucleotide bases found after parsing input.")
    if not VALID_DNA_RE.match(cleaned):
        invalid = sorted(set(cleaned) - {"A", "C", "G", "T", "N"})
        raise ValueError(
            f"Invalid nucleotide character(s) found: {', '.join(invalid)}. "
            "Allowed bases: A, C, G, T, U, N."
        )
    return cleaned


def parse_fasta(raw: str, default_name: str = "sequence") -> list[tuple[str, str]]:
    """Parse raw DNA or multi-FASTA text into a list of (record_name, cleaned_seq)."""
    if not raw or not raw.strip():
        raise ValueError("FASTA / DNA input is empty.")

    records: list[tuple[str, list[str]]] = []
    current_name: str | None = None
    current_chunks: list[str] = []

    for line in raw.strip().splitlines():
        stripped = line.strip()
        if not stripped or stripped.startswith(";"):
            continue
        if stripped.startswith(">"):
            if current_name is not None or current_chunks:
                records.append((current_name or default_name, current_chunks))
            header = stripped[1:].strip()
            current_name = header.split()[0] if header else f"{default_name}_{len(records) + 1}"
            current_chunks = []
        else:
            if current_name is None:
                current_name = default_name
            current_chunks.append(stripped)

    if current_name is not None or current_chunks:
        records.append((current_name or default_name, current_chunks))

    parsed: list[tuple[str, str]] = []
    for idx, (name, chunks) in enumerate(records, start=1):
        joined = re.sub(r"[\s0-9]+", "", "".join(chunks)).upper().replace("U", "T")
        if not joined:
            continue
        if not VALID_DNA_RE.match(joined):
            invalid = sorted(set(joined) - {"A", "C", "G", "T", "N"})
            raise ValueError(
                f"Invalid nucleotide character(s) in record '{name}': {', '.join(invalid)}."
            )
        parsed.append((name or f"{default_name}_{idx}", joined))

    if not parsed:
        raise ValueError("No valid DNA sequence records found in input.")
    return parsed

def score_cfd_mismatch(
    position_1based: int,
    guide_base: str,
    protospacer_base: str,
    enzyme: str = "spcas9",
) -> MismatchDetail:
    """Compute position-specific CFD tolerance factor for a single RNA:DNA mismatch."""
    enz = normalize_enzyme(enzyme)
    weights = SPCAS9_POS_WEIGHTS if enz == "spcas9" else CAS12A_POS_WEIGHTS
    if not (1 <= position_1based <= len(weights)):
        raise ValueError(
            f"Position {position_1based} out of range for {enz} (1..{len(weights)})."
        )

    g_base = guide_base.upper().replace("U", "T")
    p_base = protospacer_base.upper().replace("U", "T")
    target_dna, pair = rna_dna_pair_label(g_base, p_base)
    in_seed = is_seed_position(position_1based, enz)
    wobble = pair in WOBBLE_PAIRS

    if g_base == p_base:
        factor = 1.0
    elif g_base == "N" or p_base == "N":
        factor = round(weights[position_1based - 1] * 0.5, 4)
    else:
        base_p = weights[position_1based - 1]
        mult = MISMATCH_ODDS_MULTIPLIERS.get(pair, 0.70)
        # Boltzmann odds-ratio transformation keeps strict monotonicity in position & pair type
        factor = (base_p * mult) / (base_p * mult + (1.0 - base_p))
        factor = round(factor, 4)

    return MismatchDetail(
        position=position_1based,
        guide_base=g_base,
        protospacer_base=p_base,
        target_dna_base=target_dna,
        pair=pair,
        is_seed=in_seed,
        is_wobble=wobble,
        cfd_factor=factor,

        return 0.0
    else:

        if p in {"TTTA", "TTTC", "TTTG"}:
            return 1.0
        if include_noncanonical:

def score_offtarget_cfd(
    guide: str,
    protospacer: str,

                seed_positions.append(idx + 1)

    # Consecutive mismatches inside the PAM-proximal seed strongly destabilize R-loop propagation
    adjacent_seed_pairs = sum(
        1 for a, b in zip(seed_positions, seed_positions[1:]) if b == a + 1
    )
    if adjacent_seed_pairs > 0:
        score *= 0.82 ** adjacent_seed_pairs

    return round(score, 5), round(p_score, 4), "".join(align_chars), tuple(details)


def _classify_risk_tier(cfd_score: float) -> str:
    if cfd_score >= 0.50:
        return "critical"
    if cfd_score >= 0.20:
        return "high"
    if cfd_score >= 0.05:
        return "moderate"
    return "low"


def _iter_strand_sites(
    seq: str,
    enzyme: str,
    include_noncanonical_pam: bool,
) -> Iterable[tuple[int, int, str, str, float]]:
    """Yield (start, end, protospacer, pam, pam_score) along a single 5'->3' strand."""
    length = len(seq)
    if enzyme == "spcas9":
        if length < 23:
            return
        allowed_dinucs = (
            SPCAS9_PAM_SCORES if include_noncanonical_pam else {"GG": 1.0}
        )
        for i in range(length - 22):
            dinuc = seq[i + 21 : i + 23]
            p_score = allowed_dinucs.get(dinuc)
            if p_score is not None:
                protospacer = seq[i : i + 20]
                if "N" in protospacer:
                    continue
                pam = seq[i + 20 : i + 23]
                yield i, i + 23, protospacer, pam, p_score
    else:
        if length < 27:
            return
        allowed_pams = (
            CAS12A_PAM_SCORES
            if include_noncanonical_pam
            else {"TTTA": 1.0, "TTTC": 1.0, "TTTG": 1.0}
        )
        for i in range(length - 26):
            pam = seq[i : i + 4]
            p_score = allowed_pams.get(pam)
            if p_score is not None:
                protospacer = seq[i + 4 : i + 27]
                if "N" in protospacer:
                    continue
                yield i, i + 27, protospacer, pam, p_score


def scan_offtargets(
    guide: str,
    background: str | Sequence[tuple[str, str]],
    enzyme: str = "spcas9",
    max_mismatches: int = 4,
    include_noncanonical_pam: bool = True,
    exclude_locus: tuple[str, int, str] | None = None,
    exclude_one_exact: bool = False,
    top_n: int = 25,
) -> OffTargetSummary:
    """Scan both strands of background sequence(s) for PAM-adjacent off-targets <= max_mismatches.

    Args:
        guide: Candidate 20 nt (SpCas9) or 23 nt (LbCas12a) spacer sequence.
        background: Raw DNA/FASTA text or list of (contig_name, cleaned_seq) tuples.
        enzyme: 'spcas9' or 'cas12a'.
        max_mismatches: Maximum Hamming distance to report (default 4).
        include_noncanonical_pam: Whether to include NAG/NGA/etc. (SpCas9) or TTTT/CTTV (Cas12a).
        exclude_locus: Optional (contig, start, strand) tuple identifying the on-target self site.
        exclude_one_exact: If True, skips the first exact canonical match (0 mismatches, PAM=1.0).
        top_n: Maximum number of top-ranked hits to keep in `top_hits` (all hits count in specificity).
    """
    enz = normalize_enzyme(enzyme)
    g = clean_dna(guide)
    expected_len = 20 if enz == "spcas9" else 23
    if len(g) != expected_len:
        raise ValueError(f"{enz} guide must be {expected_len} nt long (got {len(g)}).")
    if max_mismatches < 0 or max_mismatches > 8:
        raise ValueError("max_mismatches must be between 0 and 8.")

    if isinstance(background, str):
        contigs = parse_fasta(background, default_name="background")
    else:
        contigs = [(name, clean_dna(seq)) for name, seq in background]

    hits: list[OffTargetHit] = []
    skipped_exact = False
    scanned_bp = 0

    for contig_name, seq in contigs:
        seq_len = len(seq)
        scanned_bp += seq_len
        rc_seq = reverse_complement(seq)

        for strand, scan_seq in (("+", seq), ("-", rc_seq)):
            for raw_start, raw_end, protospacer, pam, p_score in _iter_strand_sites(
                scan_seq, enz, include_noncanonical_pam
            ):
                # Fast Hamming distance filter before detailed CFD calculation
                mm_count = 0
                for a, b in zip(g, protospacer):
                    if a != b:
                        mm_count += 1
                        if mm_count > max_mismatches:
                            break
                if mm_count > max_mismatches:
                    continue

                if strand == "+":
                    genomic_start, genomic_end = raw_start, raw_end
                else:
                    genomic_start = seq_len - raw_end
                    genomic_end = seq_len - raw_start

                if exclude_locus is not None and (
                    contig_name == exclude_locus[0]
                    and genomic_start == exclude_locus[1]
                    and strand == exclude_locus[2]
                ):
                    continue

                if exclude_one_exact and not skipped_exact and mm_count == 0 and p_score >= 1.0:
                    skipped_exact = True
                    continue

                cfd, pam_w, alignment, details = score_offtarget_cfd(
                    g,
                    protospacer,
                    pam,
                    enzyme=enz,
                    include_noncanonical_pam=include_noncanonical_pam,
                )
                seed_mm = sum(1 for d in details if d.is_seed)
                wobble_mm = sum(1 for d in details if d.is_wobble)
                hits.append(
                    OffTargetHit(
                        contig=contig_name,
                        start=genomic_start,
                        end=genomic_end,
                        strand=strand,
                        protospacer=protospacer,
                        pam=pam,
                        pam_score=pam_w,
                        alignment=alignment,
                        mismatches=mm_count,
                        seed_mismatches=seed_mm,
                        wobble_mismatches=wobble_mm,
                        cfd_score=cfd,
                        risk_tier=_classify_risk_tier(cfd),
                        mismatch_details=details,
                    )
                )

    hits.sort(key=lambda h: (-h.cfd_score, h.mismatches, h.contig, h.start))
    total_cfd = sum(h.cfd_score for h in hits)
    specificity = round(100.0 / (1.0 + total_cfd), 2)
    high_risk = sum(1 for h in hits if h.cfd_score >= 0.20)
    canonical_hits = sum(1 for h in hits if h.pam_score >= 1.0)
    noncanonical_hits = len(hits) - canonical_hits

    return OffTargetSummary(
        guide=g,
        enzyme=enz,
        max_mismatches=max_mismatches,
        specificity_score=specificity,
        total_cfd_sum=round(total_cfd, 5),
        total_hits=len(hits),
        high_risk_hits=high_risk,
        canonical_pam_hits=canonical_hits,
        noncanonical_pam_hits=noncanonical_hits,
        scanned_bp=scanned_bp,
        scanned_contigs=len(contigs),
        top_hits=tuple(hits[:top_n]),
    )

def get_sample(sample_id: str) -> SamplePreset:
    """Retrieve a sample preset by ID (case-insensitive)."""
    key = sample_id.strip().lower()

        raise ValueError(f"Unknown sample '{sample_id}'. Available samples: {available}")
    return SAMPLES[key]
